svg.title: LUMIQ — your sheet, answered
svg.desc: Hero project: an Android app, built solo, that answers questions about a CSV or Excel file, with every number worked out and checked on the phone. 390 tests.
svg.text: 01 · HERO PROJECT · ANDROID APP · BUILT SOLO
Open a CSV or Excel file on your phone and ask it anything,
in English or Hindi. Every number is worked out on the phone
from all the rows and checked before you see it. The rows
390 tests · 66 MB APK · 0 rows uploaded · 2 languages
